author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a side-view dog facing right, with a round snout, a tail flicked up, two front legs standing and the hindquarters carried by a wheel on a strut; reads as a dog in a pet wheelchair. The head has no ear or eye, so the breed reading is generic. The rejected drawing was a tangle of lines with no body. A one-legged first attempt (attempts/v1-one-leg.svg) read as furniture.
omissions: The reference's floppy ear, raised paw and wheel hub are dropped: the head band is 6 to 17 tall, so an ear or eye cannot sit 8 from its outline, and a hub needs a wheel of r9 or more, which would overlap the legs.
drawing_plan: SQUARE: body outline back y12, neck (26,12)-(30,6), head top to (35,6), r7 snout to (42,13), jaw to (36,17), chest to y20, belly y20, r4 rump at x13; tail (13,12)-(6,6); legs x 28/36 to y42; strut (13,20)-(13,28); wheel r7 at (13,35).
lucide_reference: No Lucide side-view dog; the wheel-on-strut follows Lucide's cart and wheel circles.
